channel.title: Signal
channel.description: Tech news matched to Patrick's interests, curated daily.

item.title: Cline SDK v0.2.1 and Codex rust-v0.171.0 land agent runtime updates
item.description: Cline ships SDK v0.2.1 with signed artifact publishing and UX verification subagents, while Codex rust-v0.171.0 enables the TUI workspace by default with searchable previews and remote server execution.

item.title: Best Local LLMs in 2026: What You Can Run on a Mac mini, DGX Spark or Server
item.description: Freshly updated ranking of 51 open-weight models by the hardware they need, now including Tencent's Hy4 releases and Inkling 2 Mini scores.

item.title: Meet Thinking Machines Inkling 2 Mini: 26B Looped MoE Runs on a 32GB Mac
item.description: Technical rundown of Inkling 2 Mini's looped-transformer design: 24 stored layers reused into 48 passes, 26.4B total with 3.4B active, ~20GB checkpoint, 1M context, and GGUF builds for llama.cpp and Ollama.

item.title: MOC - Agentic Coding: Claude Code v2.1.330 and new harness launches
item.description: Daily agentic-coding digest: Claude Code v2.1.330 ships enterprise sign-in, a built-in chart mod and a 30-day scheduled-task ceiling, plus DreamCoder and the open-source Devin alternative OpenComputer launching.

item.title: Coding Agent Harness Directory (2026): 28 harnesses compared
item.description: A November 20 update to a directory comparing 28 coding-agent harnesses — lab CLIs, open-source model-neutral harnesses, and desktop and cloud runners — with prices, benchmarks, and a list of tools that shut down this year.

item.title: Inkling 2 Mini: 26B looped transformer that runs on a laptop
item.description: Thinking Machines Lab's Nov 20 release is a 26.4B MoE that loops its middle layers three times per token, fitting ~20GB and running offline on 32GB laptops while beating Qwen3.8-27B on DeepSWE v1.1.

item.title: Inkling 2 Mini: open looped model for laptops
item.description: A second look at Thinking Machines Lab's Nov 20 Inkling 2 Mini: Apache 2.0 weights, NVFP4 precision trained natively with no post-training conversion loss, and day-one GGUF builds via Unsloth and llama.cpp.

item.title: Thinking Machines Lab Releases 26.4B Inkling 2 Mini for Local Devices
item.description: Thinking Machines Lab released Inkling 2 Mini on Nov 20: a 26.4B looped-transformer MoE with a ~20GB footprint that runs locally on 32GB-class laptops via Ollama, llama.cpp and Unsloth.

item.title: Inkling Mini 2 dethrones Qwen 3.8-27B for local coding
item.description: Thinking Machines Lab's 26.4B looped-transformer Inkling 2 Mini beats Qwen3.8-27B on agentic coding benchmarks while running on 32GB-class local hardware.

item.title: Huawei MACaQ for llama.cpp and vLLM, Checked
item.description: Independent check of Huawei's MACaQ quantizer, verifying its GGUF and W4A4 claims against the repo and published weights, with fresh figures added November 20.

item.title: Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Mini runs locally on laptops
item.description: Thinking Machines' open-weights 26.4B looped-transformer model fits in ~20GB and runs on a 32GB laptop while rivalling much larger models on coding benchmarks.

item.title: Berkeley and NVIDIA Release Agentic Robot Tools
item.description: UC Berkeley and NVIDIA open-sourced agentic tooling for industrial robot programming: AI coding agents generate readable robot programs, split tasks into modular skills with Graph-as-Policy, and rehearse them in simulation before deployment.

item.title: Best open-source training and fine-tuning (Nov 2026): 73 ranked
item.description: A November 2026 ranking of 73 open-source training and fine-tuning tools, covering PEFT, Unsloth, TRL and Axolotl with current release activity and star growth for picking a LoRA stack.

item.title: AgentCore Harness on Strands: Hooks That Block Tool Calls
item.description: AWS moves its managed AgentCore harness onto the open-source Strands framework and adds four lifecycle hooks that let a Lambda allow or deny an agent tool calls.

item.title: Introducing Inkling 2 Mini
item.description: Thinking Machines' new 26.4B-parameter MoE runs in about 20GB and leads open-weights models under 100B on agentic coding benchmarks.

item.title: Ollama vs llama.cpp vs LM Studio, re-checked for llama.cpp 1.0
item.description: Fresh Nov 19 comparison covering llama.cpp v1.0.0 (Nov 13), Ollama 0.40.16 and LM Studio Bionic 1.2.1: same GGUF runs within noise across engines, so the choice comes down to packaging and defaults.

item.title: Reactive Agents v0.19.0: quieter defaults, honest run outcomes and billed costs
item.description: November release of the Reactive Agents framework makes agents quiet and private by default, states plainly how each run ended and what it cost, and lets durable runs be stopped and resumed.

item.title: Two Pendragon titles out now on Foundry VTT: The Grey Knight and The Sauvage King
item.description: Chaosium's Pendragon adventures The Grey Knight and The Sauvage King arrive on Foundry VTT with ready-to-play actors, scenes, and automated Winter Phases.

item.title: Blizzard admits WoW: Forever dungeon XP change 'missed the mark'
item.description: Blizzard walked back its Nov 13 anti-boosting XP rule after it wiped dungeon experience for ordinary groups, replacing it with a 12-level gap threshold.

item.title: llama.cpp b12500 adds fastdiv CUDA conv2d optimization
item.description: llama.cpp b12500 swaps three integer divisions for precomputed fast-division in its CUDA conv2d kernel, roughly halving that kernel's runtime on NVIDIA GPUs.

item.title: Is WoW Forever Classic Plus?
item.description: A freshly updated explainer on what Blizzard actually calls WoW: Forever, what it keeps from Classic, what it adds at launch, and why the community name Classic Plus is not the official one, with raids opening December 9.

item.title: Olala Mini 7A1B Brings Local AI to Smaller Hardware
item.description: OVHcloud's first in-house model: 7B total parameters with only 1B active per request, Apache 2.0 open weights with GGUF and MLX builds, aimed at 8 GB GPUs and CPUs — though llama.cpp and Ollama cannot load its hybrid Mamba-3 architecture yet.

item.title: Ollama vs llama.cpp, Ollama vs LM Studio: RTX 5080 Data
item.description: Same RTX 5080, two August captures: Ollama edges bare llama.cpp on dense decode while LM Studio prefills faster, and the shipped settings move throughput more than the app choice.

item.title: An AI app for Android: ForgeMind, a Kotlin workstation for cloud and local models
item.description: New open-source Android app that turns a phone into an AI workstation: cloud and local models, SSH, bidirectional MCP, and Termux as a first-class contour with on-device tool use.

item.title: Spark-X2.6-4B: 4B open model for local agents with adjustable reasoning
item.description: SparkLLM shipped Spark-X2.6-4B, a 4B open model tuned for coding and tool use with a three-level reasoning budget; the GGUF build is 3.54 GB at Q4_K_M and it claims near-9B quality on agent benchmarks.

item.title: CodeAF - Open Source Coding Agent Harness
item.description: New Apache 2.0 Go harness that splits coding work into parallel tasks on separate branches, with build, security-audit and PR-review specialists, running open models via Ollama, OpenRouter or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

item.title: Microsoft Opens Copilot Harness in Foundry Agent Service for AI Agents
item.description: Microsoft put the Copilot Harness into public preview in Foundry Agent Service, a managed orchestration layer that decouples model choice from the agent loop, with the runtime free until December 1.

item.title: The Siege on Manual VTT Layout: Foundry & Fantasy Grounds Are Now Turnkey
item.description: A Basic Fantasy adventure bundle now ships native Foundry VTT and Fantasy Grounds modules compiled by an automated engine in under a minute, replacing manual VTT data entry.

item.title: GitHub Agentic Workflows Explained: AI Agents in GitHub Actions, Safety Checks and Costs
item.description: A walkthrough of GitHub Agentic Workflows' general availability: Markdown-defined coding agents running sandboxed inside GitHub Actions, with a $10 default per-run cost cap and a choice of Copilot CLI, Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, or Pi as the engine.

item.title: SenseNova-Loop-9B: SenseTime's 9B open model loops its layers twice
item.description: SenseTime's 9B Apache-2.0 model reuses its middle layers twice per pass for deeper reasoning; 4-bit weights run on under 10 GB of GPU memory with a 512K context.

item.title: Serving a local LLM to several users: Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp and vLLM benchmarked
item.description: On one RTX 3090 the four servers are within 10% for single requests, but under concurrent load the defaults diverge sharply: Ollama queues requests serially while vLLM pulls ahead, and llama.cpp needs -np raised past its 4-slot default.

item.title: MACaQ Quantizes One Layer at a Time, Across Inference Backends
item.description: A close read of Huawei's MACaQ quantizer: per-layer calibration for 2-4-bit GGUF and W4A4, with MACaQ-R refining existing GGUF files to a lower KL divergence than Unsloth's equivalent at the same size.

item.title: WoW Forever Raid Release Date: December 9
item.description: Post-launch rundown confirms the first WoW: Forever raids, Barrow Deeps, Hyjal Summit and Onyxia's Lair, unlock December 9 for level 60 players, with the live build on a stack of hotfixes dated through November 13.

item.title: Gemma 4 QAT Checkpoints vs Regular Q4 GGUFs, Measured
item.description: Measured comparison finds Unsloth's QAT GGUF for Gemma 4 E2B the smallest and closest 4-bit file, beating Google's official Q4_0 build.

item.title: Detectify launches Agentic Tooling to bring verifiable evidence to AI-led security investigations
item.description: Detectify's new Agentic Tooling lets teams' own AI agents investigate suspected vulnerabilities in their own environments via MCP and CLI, with a Security Ledger recording verifiable evidence for each finding.

item.title: Qwen Code 1.0 Preview open-sources Alibaba's Agent Harness as an embeddable runtime
item.description: Alibaba folds the production Agent Harness from its Qoder tool into Qwen Code 1.0 Preview, released under Apache-2.0 as an embeddable runtime for multi-step planning, tool orchestration, and failure recovery.

item.title: Detectify launches Agentic Tooling for AI security agents
item.description: Detectify’s new Agentic Tooling lets teams’ own AI agents probe running apps for exploitable flaws, with a Security Ledger recording verifiable evidence of what each agent actually tested.

item.title: Two hotfixes in five days: Blizzard rebalanced dungeon leveling in WoW Forever
item.description: Blizzard tuned WoW Forever dungeon XP twice in the first ten days after launch: a 50% boost on Nov 8, then a Nov 13 fix that stops high-level characters boosting low-level parties for XP.

item.title: Autonomous launches Harness, an open-source command center for AI coding agents
item.description: A free, open-source dashboard that runs Claude Code, Codex, Devin and other coding agents across local and remote machines in isolated tmux sessions, with domain packages extending them into circuit design, 3D modeling, robotics and music.

item.title: LLM Hub: Free App Runs Chat, Video, Music, and Voice Cloning Offline on Your Phone
item.description: LLM Hub packs 15+ on-device AI tools into one free Android and iOS app with no data collection or accounts, including a Termux-integrated agent that writes and runs shell commands on-device and a Vibe Coder mode backed by a local Codex server.
